title: AI-Driven Superconductor Discovery on Unified-Memory APUs: Equivariant Crystal Diffusion, Zero-Copy MACE Relaxation, and First-Principles DFT Verification
description: Closed-loop superconductor candidate discovery combining Magpie compositional screening, DiffCSP-SC equivariant crystal diffusion, native C++/HIP zero-copy MACE pre-relaxation on unified-memory APUs (AMD Strix Halo), and Quantum ESPRESSO v7.3 PBE-GGA PAW verification.
